notes:
Initial inbound from product lead (via contact form) on 2026-02-15. Wants lightweight integration: webhooks -> transcription -> Redwood hosted API for summary generation. Primary ask: how do we ensure no raw PII persisted in your systems?

Key points from discovery call (2026-02-18, 30m):
- "Customer story": 40 sales reps, records ~200 calls/day (avg 4–7 min). Prioritize short summaries + named-entity redaction; snippets pushed to CRM.
- Latency target: 1–2s per summary (after transcription), acceptable to batch 4–8 calls for cost savings but needs <500ms tail for single-call UI.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, looking for clear per-1000-token math. "We can't afford to overrun on token billing — need predictable defaults."
- Security: requires SSO for console, SOC2 evidence, audit logs for API, retention controls to auto-delete raw transcripts after 7 days unless flagged. GDPR/CCPA concerns for EU customers — currently only NA HQ but plan to expand.
- Integration: uses Segment and a custom Zapier flow; wants simple server-side SDK and webhook examples.

Recent touches:
- 2026-02-20: Sent hosted API quickstart + transient-data FAQ (drive link).
- 2026-02-25: SE session (Morgan) demoed hosted API with sample redaction pipeline; recorded FF meeting ff_20260218_0317.
- 2026-03-04: BrevityWorks ran small internal eval using free tier; reported odd behavior on entity redaction for person initials. Logged as INFRA-4521.
- 2026-03-10: Follow-up call — asked for explicit retention SLA and whether we support customer-managed KMS (they prefer not for launch).

Quotes / paraphrases: "We need to be able to say to security 'no PII leaves our environment unless we explicitly allow it' — can Redwood do that on hosted?' 

POC scope proposed:
- 2-week hosted API trial, 1 app integration (webhook -> Redwood -> redaction -> CRM push)
- Acceptance: 95% redaction of named PII on a 500-sample test set + <2s median summary latency

Open questions for Redwood AM/SE:
- Can hosted API support automatic redaction hooks (server-side) or do we need to run a preprocessor?
- Exact retention controls (auto-delete raw transcripts after X days) and where cached KV is stored/residency.
- Is there a lightweight SLA or credit for SMB trial volume overages?

Next steps (short):

- Provision trial key scoped to data-retention policy; provide sample SDK snippet for redaction pipeline (owner: Morgan).
- Schedule follow-up 30m call wk of 2026-03-17 (owner: Riley).
